blurb: Big Shoulders Yoga offers a variety of Hatha yoga classes ranging from gentle and restorative to dynamic and challenging. Classes are held in-person at their West Town Chicago studio and online via Zoom. They provide props and free mats, and their studio is kept warm between 75°F and 85°F.
extraNote: All sales are final · Auto renew memberships can be canceled anytime up to 48 hours before renewal by emailing info@bigshouldersyoga.com · Class packs expire 6 months after purchase date · Sliding scale pricing operates by honor system; use only if genuinely needed · Studio opens 20 minutes prior to class start; late arrivals may be locked out · Yoga studio in West Town, Chicago, just west of Ashland Avenue and Chicago Avenue intersection.
